idea-plugin.name: Moonlight 4 Seasons
idea-plugin.description:
Four Moonlight-inspired color themes for every JetBrains IDE: Dark, Paper, Green and Light.

  • Moonlight Dark: bubblegum colors on a moonlit dark background
  • Moonlight Paper: warm, paper-like light theme with vivid syntax colors
  • Moonlight Green: deep green tones with mint accents
  • Moonlight Light: soft, cool off-white light theme

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, WebStorm, PyCharm and other IDEs based on the IntelliJ platform. Blur variants are available for the Zed editor only (JetBrains IDEs do not support window transparency).

Based on Moonlight by atomiks (MIT license). Source code and screenshots: github.com/Lyriraki/moonlight-4-seasons
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 First public release: Dark, Paper, Green and Light themes.
